newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR MIXED IN DULL INTERBANK TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR MIXED IN DULL INTERBANK TRADE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against hard currencies as interbank trade resumed on a dull note on Tuesday after Monday's public holiday.
"There's been really nothing happening since opening. I don't think the customers have come into the market as yet," a foreign exchange dealer said.

At around 0750 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading at 11.2900/3000 versus the key U.S. dollar, where it closed last Friday, but was quoted softer on sterling at 18.4730/5000 from 18.4150/4450, reflecting a weaker U.S. dollar overseas.
It was also easier against the rand at 2.5235/5240 compared to 2.5200/5250 but was however quoted firmer at 6.6620/6635 against the mark from 6.6760/6800.
